3. Approval of Vice Chancellor, KVAFSU Bidar
The University has published the list of accepted and not accepted online
applications for admission to undergraduate programs under the NRI, OCI, PIO/NRI-C, and
NRI-S categories for the academic year 2024-25 (vide ref. 01). In light of technical
constraints, applicants listed in the "NOT ACCEPTABLE" list as mentioned in reference (1)
are hereby permitted to appear for offline verification of original documents, along with the
deficient documents on 07-10-2024, between 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM, at the Veterinary
College, Hebbal, Bengaluru campus. Further, only the deficient documents specified in
reference (1) will be accepted. Any additional documents beyond those specified will not be
considered.
